description: gen schema generates the committed processing/bind schema itself, read by suite path, which declares an object type named Item: the generated crate names its processor enum ItemKind instead of Item, so the declared record type and the enum coexist, and a schema crate spells the prelude and engine names it uses by path (::core::option::Option, ::std::vec::Vec, ::kdlith_engine::Ref, ::kdlith_engine::OrderedMap). It generates twice into two scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical, the generated text pins the ItemKind enum, its re-export, the local Item struct, and the qualified field spellings, and the generated crate compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template. The compiled processor loads the schema with the digest the reference CLI reports and reads a committed data document from the suite root, printing each declaration and record under its ItemKind variant with each value as vet data binds it: the group declaration with its ordered labels, an item record of the declared Item type with its context-supplied locale and its reference to the group, an item under a children override with its fixed region, and the typeless stamp record reading its locale from context
